forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the email you use for {{office}}'s panel. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account on {{office}}'s panel, we sent a link to choose a new password. It works for 24 hours. Not there? Check your spam folder.

choosePassword.greeting: Hi {{name}}. You will sign in as {{email}}.
choosePassword.invalidBody: Links to choose a password work once and expire.

projects.emptyBody: Create a project to track its stages, next meeting and latest updates.
projects.title: Projects
projects.disconnectedBody: Projects are hidden until Google Drive is reconnected. The files remain in the Drive folder.
projects.disconnectedMember: Projects are hidden until the office owner reconnects Google Drive.
projects.needsDrive: To create projects, connect the office's Google Drive.
projects.needsDriveMember: To create projects, the office's Google Drive needs to be connected. Ask the office's owner.

newProject.recipientsHint: These contacts receive email updates about files, stages and meetings. You can also add them later.
newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Project name
newProject.clientHint: As shown on the client's page.
newProject.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. The page will be {{address}}
newProject.slugTakenBy: This address already belongs to “{{name}}”. Choose another.

newProject.noStagesHint: No stages selected. You can add stages on the project page.

newProject.stagesHint_one: {{count}} stage ticked. The type's usual stages come ticked; tick or untick as you like.
newProject.stagesHint_other: {{count}} stages ticked. The type's usual stages come ticked; tick or untick as you like.

clientEmails.title: Client emails
clientEmails.intro: Contacts on this list receive email updates for “{{name}}”: new files, stages and meetings.

projectSettings.recipientsHint: Clients will automatically get updates about the project by email.
projectSettings.title: Project
projectSettings.name: Project name
projectSettings.linkHint: The page is at {{address}}. The old link keeps working.
projectSettings.publicHint: Anyone with the link can access the page.
projectSettings.withPasswordHint: The client types it once per device; it lasts 90 days.
projectSettings.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password. If you change it, clients will need to enter it again on all devices.
projectSettings.passwordNew: At least 6 characters. Send it to the client with the link.
projectSettings.archiveMeans: The project leaves the list, but its page remains available to clients. Portal uploads and update emails are disabled.

update.available: A new version of the dashboard is available.

errors.signin_not_configured: Signing in with Google isn't set up in this environment.
errors.version_type_mismatch: The new version must be the same type of file as the current one.

errors.owner_only: Only the office's owner can do this.

errors.invalid_status_change: This project's status couldn't be changed. Reload the page and try again.

errors.cover_too_large: Choose an image of up to 10 MB.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.password_required: Set a password to protect the page.

errors.folder_exists: This stage already has a section with that name.

errors.file_not_ours_to_move: This file wasn't sent through the site. To move it to another stage, move it into that stage's folder.
errors.invalid_detail: Check the details: use each field once, keep text within 40 characters, enter numbers for areas and valid dates.
errors.invalid_meeting: Check the meeting details: a subject of up to 40 characters, a future date, an end time after the start and a link beginning with https://.
errors.invalid_stage: This stage couldn't be changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.files_unavailable: The file couldn't be opened just now. Try again in a moment.
errors.share_not_found: This link is no longer available. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
errors.share_too_large: Each link can hold up to 300 MB. Untick some files or make more than one link.
errors.share_files_changed: Some files changed since the page opened. Reload the page and try again.
errors.share_daily_limit: This link has reached today's download limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.account_exists: There is already an account with this email. Sign in, or use “Forgot your password?”.
errors.email_unconfirmed: Confirm your email to continue. Reload the page.
errors.email_code_wrong: Wrong code. Check the email and try again.

errors.already_confirmed: This email is already confirmed. Reload the page.
errors.share_locked: This link is protected by a password. Go back to the files and type it.
errors.wrong_share_password: Wrong password. Check with whoever sent the link.

errors.operator_action_failed: Could not complete this action. Try again and contact support with the code if it continues.
errors.operator_actions_unavailable: Administration actions are not available yet.
errors.signup_link_invalid: This link to create an office no longer works: it was used or is over 7 days old. Ask Unio for a new one.
errors.office_address_taken: That address is already in use. Choose another.
errors.invalid_office_address: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.

drive.intro: Project files stay in your office’s Google Drive, organized in folders accessible through the portal.
drive.notConnectedBody: Connecting creates a “Portal Clientes” folder in your Drive to organize projects. The files remain in your account.
drive.openFolder: Open the folder in Google Drive
drive.expiredBody: Client pages remain available. Reconnect to upload files and create projects.
drive.readerProblem: The portal cannot read the folder. Check it was not moved or unshared.
drive.localBody: On this computer, projects use the local example folders.
drive.disconnectConfirm: The portal stops reaching your Drive now. Files stay in the folder.
drive.ownerOnly: Only the office's owner can connect or disconnect.
drive.noticeExpired: The Google Drive connection has expired. Client pages remain available. Reconnect to upload files and create projects.
drive.spaceLow: Storage is running low. Free up space or increase your account’s storage to continue uploading files.
drive.spaceUnknown: Drive space couldn't be checked right now.
drive.notConnectedBefore: Previously connected as {{email}}. The projects are in that account's folder.
drive.switchWarning: Existing files will not be transferred. Projects will have empty folders in the new account.
drive.switchFiles: Files, cover images and logos remain in the previous account.
drive.switchEmpty: Clients will no longer see the files until they are uploaded again through the website to the new account.
drive.switchKept: Names, stages, notes, details, meetings and the clients' emails stay as they are.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.storageHint: Connecting creates a “Portal Clientes” folder in your Google Drive, with a subfolder for each project.
firstSteps.officeHint: Add the contact email and the logo (optional). They appear on the pages and emails clients receive.
firstSteps.firstProjectHint: Each project gets a page where the client follows stages, files and meetings.
firstSteps.membersNote: Only the office's owner can complete these steps.
firstSteps.exampleIntro: Explore the page your clients will use, with stages, files and meetings in an example project.

office.name: Office name
office.nameHint: Shown at the top of client pages and in the browser tab.
office.emailHint: Used as the reply-to address on emails to clients.
office.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 5 MB. After choosing, you adjust the crop.
office.logoNeedsDrive: Connect Google Drive to upload a logo. It will be stored in your office’s account.
office.logoDriveUnreadable: The portal can't read the office's Google Drive folder, so the logo can't be uploaded now. Check the connection under Google Drive.
office.ownerOnly: Only the office's owner can change these details.
office.darkSame: Use the same logo in dark mode
office.darkHint: For dark backgrounds, such as a light version of the logo.
office.darkLogoRemoved: Dark mode uses the same logo.

painelTour.first-steps: Connect Google Drive, customize your office details and create your first project. Progress updates automatically.
painelTour.new-project: Each project gets a page for the client to follow. You give its name, the client, the type and the stages.
painelTour.project-card: Select a project to edit its page and upload files. Use the ⋯ menu to change the cover, open settings or archive the project.
painelTour.settings: The office's details, which clients see, and the Google Drive connection.
painelTour.example: Explore an example project with stages, files and a meeting. Changes are not saved.

crop.logoHint: Drag the edges so only the logo is inside, with no margins. Empty margins were already trimmed.
crop.coverHint: Drag to choose the part of the photo that shows. The cover has the same shape on every screen.
crop.inTheBar: How it looks at the top of the pages
crop.unreadable: This image couldn't be opened. Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG file.

tour.stage: Stages are independent: mark each one as done when it is finished, in any order. The client follows along and gets the updates by email.
tour.mode: “View as client” shows the page exactly as the client sees it. In “Edit”, you change what it shows, right here.
tour.pencils: Name, description, details and meeting: tap a part's pencil to edit it. The client sees the change once saved.
tour.upload: Drop files here or choose them from your computer: they go to the stage's Google Drive folder and show to the client. In each file's “⋯”, you move it, hide it or make it the cover.
tour.link: Copy the address and send it to the client. Come back to this tour any time with the “?” button.

page.noFilesTitle: No files in this stage yet
page.noFilesBody: They'll show up here as soon as the office sends them.
page.noFilesDone: This stage was finished without files.
page.noMeeting: The next meeting will appear here.
page.notFoundBody: Check the link with the office. If the project moved, ask for the new link.
page.unavailableBody: This page is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
page.unavailableStaff: The office's Google Drive is disconnected. Reconnect it in Settings so clients can see their pages again.
page.lockedBody: This page is protected by a password. Enter the password the office sent you; this device stays unlocked for 90 days.
page.filesUnavailable: The files couldn't be loaded just now. Try again in a moment.

edit.versionCurrentNote: Stays in Drive as it is and stays in the list of versions as v{{version}}.
edit.versionNewNote: Saved with this name. It is what the client sees from now on.
edit.versionClash: Another file in this folder has the same version. Rename one of them in Google Drive.
edit.completeProjectMeans: All stages are done. The project will appear as completed to the client. You will be able to reopen it later by reopening a stage.
edit.completeStageMeans: The stage will be marked as done for the client. You will be able to reopen it later.
edit.reopenStageMeans: The stage will appear as open to the client again.
edit.reopenStageOfCompletedMeans: The stage will appear as open again, and the project will no longer appear as completed.
edit.reorderHint: Drag a stage to change the order. Each stage keeps its completion; the Drive folders follow.
edit.reorderHintTouch: Press and hold a stage for a moment, then drag to change the order, or drag by the handle on the left. Each stage keeps its completion; the Drive folders follow.
edit.reorderCancelled: Move cancelled: {{title}} is back in its place.
edit.reorderKeys: To move the stage, press space, use the up and down arrows, then press space again. Escape cancels.
edit.noClientEmail: This project has no client registered to receive updates yet.
edit.noClientEmailWhy: Add the client’s email to send updates about files, stages and meetings.
edit.name: Project name
edit.nameHint: Shown at the top of the client's page and in the dashboard. The page's address stays the same.
edit.dropNote: Files are stored in the “{{folder}}” folder in your Drive and appear for the client. Up to {{max}} MB per file.
edit.dropNoteSection: Files go into the “{{section}}” section and appear for the client. Up to {{max}} MB per file.
edit.sectionEmpty: No files in this section yet. The client will see it once it has files.
edit.hideSectionNote: Its files stay in Google Drive
edit.hideSectionMeans_one: The section and its file will no longer show on the page, for the client or the team. The file stays in Google Drive, in the folder “_{{section}}”.
edit.hideSectionMeans_other: The section and its {{count}} files will no longer show on the page, for the client or the team. The files stay in Google Drive, in the folder “_{{section}}”.
edit.hideSectionEmpty: The section will no longer show on the page. The folder stays in Google Drive as “_{{section}}”.
edit.hideSectionUndo: To show it again, rename the folder in Google Drive without the leading _.
edit.fileHidden: “{{name}}” no longer shows to the client. In Drive, it now starts with _.
edit.archivedNoEdit: Archived project: restore it in the dashboard to edit.
edit.descriptionHint: Each line becomes a paragraph. Start with “- ” for a list.
edit.noDescription: Add a brief project description for the client.
edit.subject: Subject
edit.notesPlaceholder: Check the plans and send your comments before the meeting.
edit.removeStageConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from the page? Its folder and files stay in Drive.
edit.stageRemoved: Stage “{{title}}” removed. Its folder stays in Drive.
edit.addStageHint: The stage will be added at the end, with a new folder in Drive.
edit.clientsNotified: Clients subscribed to this project will be notified by email.
edit.addCoverHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. After choosing, you adjust the crop.

email.inviteIntro: {{inviter}} invited you to {{office}}'s panel, where the team looks after the project pages. To come in, choose your password:
email.inviteExpiry: This link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
email.inviteIgnore: If you weren’t expecting this invitation, ignore this email. Access is only activated after a password is set.
email.confirmSubject: {{code}} is your code to join {{office}}'s panel
email.confirmIntro: To confirm this email is yours and finish joining {{office}}'s panel, type this code on the sign-up screen:
email.confirmExpiry: The code and the link work for 24 hours.
email.confirmIgnore: If you didn't sign up, ignore this email. The account won't work without confirmation.
email.welcomeIntro: From now on, this email gets the updates of {{office}}'s project {{project}}: new files, stages and meetings.
email.welcomeNotYou: Don’t recognize this subscription or prefer not to receive updates?
email.subject: News on {{project}}
email.why: You get these emails because {{office}} added your address to the {{project}} project.
email.unsubscribe: I don't want these emails anymore
email.unsubscribeAsk: {{email}} will no longer get news on the {{project}} project by email.
email.unsubscribed: {{email}} will no longer receive updates for {{project}}.
email.unsubscribeInvalid: This link no longer works. If you still get emails you don't want, contact the office.
email.resetIntro: We received a request to reset your password for {{office}}'s panel. Use the button below to choose a new one.
email.resetExpiry: The link works once and expires in 24 hours.
email.resetIgnore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

updates.label: Updates
updates.title: Latest updates
updates.empty: No updates yet. New files, notes and meetings will show here.

files.pdfHint: PDF document. Use “Open original” to see the whole file.
files.otherHint: Open the file to view it in a suitable app.

example.bannerHint: Try anything. Reloading the page starts it over.

exploreTour.timeline: The list shows the project's stages and which ones are done. Click a stage to open it.
exploreTour.title: The first thing the client sees on the project's page.
exploreTour.description: A summary of the project, written by the office, with paragraphs and lists.
exploreTour.details: Client, location, areas and dates: you choose which appear.
exploreTour.summary: On a phone, the description and details are here, one tap away.
exploreTour.meeting: Day, time and place, with a button to add it to a calendar.
exploreTour.files: What you put in the stage's folder in Google Drive appears here. Click a file to preview, save or send it.
exploreTour.updates: New files, notes, meetings and finished stages gather here, so the client misses nothing.
exploreTour.edit: In “Edit”, change anything: nothing is saved, and reloading the page undoes it all.
exploreTour.end: Go back to Getting started in the dashboard to connect Google Drive and create your first project.

emailField.tooMany: The limit of {{max}} email addresses has been reached. Remove one to add another.
emailField.invalid: Enter a valid email address, such as contact@example.com.
emailField.invalidSome_one: This doesn't look like an email: {{emails}}. Check it and try again.
emailField.invalidSome_other: These don't look like emails: {{emails}}. Check them and try again.

team.title: Team

roleHint.member: Looks after projects: pages, files, meetings.
roleHint.owner: Also invites people and looks after the settings and Google Drive.

team.inviteIntro: They will receive an email to set their password. You can also copy the link and share it through WhatsApp.
team.name: Name
team.invited: Invitation sent to {{email}}. You can also share the link:
team.notEmailed: The email could not be sent. Copy the link and share it with the person you invited:
team.alreadyIn: {{name}} is already on the team with this email.
team.linkIntro: Share this link to invite people to the team. It is valid for 24 hours and does not grant administrator access.
team.linkNewNote: A new link turns the previous one off.
team.linkOnce: Copy and share it now: for safety, the link shows only once and works for 24 hours. After that, create a new one.

join.title: Join {{office}}'s team
join.intro: Enter your name, email and a password. Then confirm the email with the code we'll send.
join.invalidBody: It was turned off or replaced by a new one. Ask whoever runs the office for the current link.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email
confirmEmail.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Type it below to open the panel.
confirmEmail.resent: We sent a new code to {{email}}.
confirmEmail.linkIntro: Confirm this email is yours to finish joining the panel.
confirmEmail.doneBody: You're all set. You can open the panel now.
confirmEmail.invalidBody: It expired or was already used. Sign in to the panel to get a new code.

subscribe.title: Updates by email
subscribe.intro: Get an email when there are new files, a stage changes or a meeting is set.
subscribe.sent: {{email}} is now subscribed to updates for this project.
subscribe.archived: This project no longer sends updates.

preview.title: Project page preview
preview.hint: This preview uses fictional data. Nothing is saved or sent to Drive. Share the address to show your selected options.

share.passwordHint: Whoever gets the link will need to type this password to open the shared files.
share.protectedNote: Protected by a password: send it separately.
share.lockedBody: Type the password you were given with the link.
share.pickFilesHint: Open a stage and tick its files one by one.
share.introStage: Choose the files from {{stage}} you want to share. We make a link that offers them for download for as long as you choose.
share.wholeStagesHint: The link holds the files each stage has today.
share.intro: Choose the files you want to share. We make a link that offers them for download for as long as you choose.
share.noFiles: There are no files to share yet.
share.filesUnavailable: The files couldn't be loaded just now. Try again in a moment.
share.label: For whom? (Optional)
share.readyHint: Send this link to whoever is receiving the files.
share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
share.noLinksStaff: Links made for this project, by the team or the client, appear here with their downloads. You can copy or turn them off at any time.
share.noLinksMine: Links made on this device appear here. You can copy or turn them off at any time.
share.disableText: Whoever has the link will no longer be able to download the files. This can't be undone.
share.checkFailed: The files couldn't be checked just now.
share.sharedFrom: Files from the project {{project}}, shared by {{office}}.
share.gone_one: {{count}} shared file is no longer available.
share.gone_other: {{count}} shared files are no longer available.
share.allGone: The files in this link are no longer available.

admin.title: Unio operations
admin.signInIntro: Sign in with an authorized Google account to see the platform's offices.

signInProblem.tentativas: Too many attempts to sign in with Google. Try again in 15 minutes.
signInProblem.expirado: The sign-in attempt expired. Try again.
signInProblem.negado: This Google account has no access here.
signInProblem.falhou: Signing in with Google didn't finish. Try again in a moment.

admin.supportIntro: Paste the code shown on the client's error screen to open that request's logs.
admin.supportInvalid: The code has 32 letters and digits.
admin.logsOnlyDeployed: Logs are only available on the published site.
admin.errorsOpen: Open this office's errors in the logs (7 days)
admin.downloadMeaning: Shared-link downloads started, including interrupted transfers.
admin.fileStatsScope: Loaded only on request. Visible stage files, including older versions and archived projects. Excludes hidden files, covers and logos.
admin.accountSpaceMeaning: Usage across account services; may include pooled organization storage. This is not just Unio storage. A missing limit does not mean unlimited space.

actions.name: Office name
actions.hostnameHint: Where the office's team and clients will open Unio.
actions.slugHint: Filled in from the address. It identifies the office in PostHog and in the logs and cannot be changed later.
actions.ownerHelp: Copy this link and send it to the owner. It works once and expires in 7 days. It will not be shown again after you close this window.
actions.signupLinkExplain: Make a link for someone to create their own office: they choose its name and address, then create the owner account. The link works once and lasts 7 days.
actions.signupLinkHelp: Copy this link and send it to whoever will create the office. It works once and lasts 7 days. It won't be shown again after you close this window.

explain.owner_link: Generate a new owner signup link for {{name}}?
explain.suspend: Suspend {{name}}? Its panel and pages will be unavailable until restored.
explain.restore: Restore {{name}} and make its panel and pages available again?
explain.delete: Permanently delete {{name}} data in Unio? Drive files will be preserved. This cannot be undone.

signup.title: Create your office on Unio
signup.intro: Choose the name your clients will see and the address for your project pages. Next, you create your owner account.
signup.name: Office name
signup.nameHint: As clients see it. You can change it later.
signup.addressHint: Where your team and clients will open Unio. It can't be changed later.
signup.next: Next, you enter your name, email and password and confirm the email with a code.
